name: perchlight-privacy
description: A free, self-hosted privacy and compliance checker for websites you own, on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + one small Durable Object. Static checks only; no cron trigger. Not legal advice.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Required. A long random string (16+ characters), e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Protects the admin API (/api/*) and the report pages.

ALERT_WEBHOOKS.description: Optional. JSON: webhook name to URL, e.g. {"discord-ops":"https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..."}. Names are listed in privacy.json alerts.webhooks. A secret: a webhook URL is a credential.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Needed for JSON alert webhooks. 16+ random characters: JSON alerts are signed with HMAC-SHA256 of it.

HEARTBEAT_URL.description: Optional. An https URL fetched after Scanner runs (at most every 5 minutes), for example a perchlight-hooks or healthchecks.io heartbeat, so you hear about it if this tool stops.
